tools.name: mcp_status
tools.title: Check MCP status
tools.description: Reports whether the MCP diagnostic endpoint is running; does not access user data.

tools.name: mcp_guide
tools.title: Tool guide
tools.description: Describes the tools this user can call. Without arguments it lists every module available and the tools of each one; with module it details every tool of that module; with tool it details a single tool. Use it before acting with a tool you do not already know. Reads only: it changes nothing.

module.description: Module to detail, as named in the list: files, notes, calendar, contacts, tasks, deck, talk, people, logs. Only the modules available to this user are accepted.

tool.description: Single tool to detail, by its technical name (for example files_edit). Takes precedence over module.

tools.name: files_share
tools.title: Share file or folder
tools.description: Share a file or folder of yours with a person or a group, or change how it is already shared with them. Find the account or group id with users_search first (include_groups: true for groups); never guess it. Sharing again with the same recipient changes that share instead of creating another one. permission is view (open and download) or edit (change; on a folder also add and delete inside it); a share never lets the recipient share it on. expires is the last day (YYYY-MM-DD, in the user's timezone, tomorrow or later); omit it to keep the current one, or for a new share to get the administrator's default. Without confirm: true it returns the plan and changes nothing. Nextcloud notifies the recipient. Needs the "share" permission. with: "link" creates or changes the public link of the file (one per file, view only, anyone with it can open it) and needs the "link" permission; its password is generated by the server when you pass password: true or the administrator requires one, and is returned once in the confirmed result only.

path.description: Path of the file or folder, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf

with.description: Recipient: user:<uid> for a person, group:<gid> for a group, or link for a public link.

permission.description: view to open and download; edit to change too (on a folder: add, change and delete inside it).

expires.description: Last day of access, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's timezone, tomorrow or later.

note.description: Note shown to the recipient with the share; an empty string removes the current note.

password.description: Public link only: true makes the server generate a new password, which replaces the current one and is shown once in the result. Never choose a password yourself.

plan_state.description: Opaque value of the plan. Send it back unchanged together with confirm: true. If the state changed since the plan, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan.

confirm.description: Send true only after you have shown the plan of this call to the user and the user explicitly said yes. Without it nothing is changed and the answer is the plan.

tools.name: files_unshare
tools.title: Stop sharing file or folder
tools.description: Stop sharing a file or folder of yours: removes one share you created, so that person, group or public link loses access. Name the share with the shareId from files_list_shares, or with path plus with (user:<uid>, group:<gid> or link). Nothing is deleted: the file or folder and its content stay as they are. Only your own shares of your own files can be removed; a Talk attachment is removed in Talk. Without confirm: true it returns the plan and changes nothing. Needs the "share" permission; removing a public link needs "link".

shareId.description: The shareId of the share to remove, exactly as files_list_shares returns it (for example ocinternal:123). Use it alone, or use path with with instead.

path.description: File or folder of yours, e.g. /Documents/report.pdf. Use it together with with.

with.description: Whose share to remove from path: user:<uid>, group:<gid> or link. Use it together with path.

plan_state.description: Opaque value of the plan. Send it back unchanged together with confirm: true. If the state changed since the plan, nothing is written and the answer is the new plan.

confirm.description: Send true only after you have shown the plan of this call to the user and the user explicitly said yes. Without it nothing is changed and the answer is the plan.
